title: Hidden Depths
description: Han Jue teaches the power of concealment. 'The deepest waters make no sound.'

challenge.requirements: Hide your true power level for 200 turns while being constantly tested
challenge.restriction: Cannot reveal any hint of your actual capabilities

title: Seclusion Mastery
description: Han Jue reveals the ultimate cultivation method. 'True power grows in solitude, away from the world's chaos.'

challenge.requirements: Achieve breakthrough while completely isolated from all external influences
challenge.restriction: Cannot interact with anyone or anything for the duration
